topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by reviewing prior practicals and outlining the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, oncogene discovery, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to experimental assays for testing transforming mutations.

topics.label: Classification and cellular mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer gene mutations and explore their functional mechanisms in cell cycle regulation using Rb and p53 as paradigms.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how defects in DNA repair pathways, DNA replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited genetic alterations drives malignant transformation and cancer development.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture by recommending further reading and looking ahead to the next session.
